name: EX-LIBRIS
source:
Ex libris are a type of stamp used to mark ownership of a book

It is common for books that passed through multiple owners to bear multiple Ex Libris

Sometimes, they cover the old one

Sometimes...

They create something new.

[From [url=https://luckeater.itch.io/ex-libris]itch.io[/url]]
